long_biography.plain_text:
Prince entered university at sixteen and completed medicine at Monash. While still a medical student, he used $16,000 in savings to open Zambrero in Canberra in 2005. The restaurant became the basis of a franchise network, with its Plate 4 Plate programme linking each purchase to a donated meal.

Next Practice brought Prince's systems approach into primary care through a licensing model for patient-centred clinics. His hospitality group developed several restaurant concepts, while Prince Group also lists consumer-drink and recruitment-technology businesses. Prince founded One Disease to address crusted scabies in remote Australian communities, combining his medical training with a business-supported social-impact model.
